messages.Este conflito é grande demais para a ger: This conflict is too large for generation. Resolve a smaller file or merge manually.
messages.O agente retornou um formato inválido. T: The agent returned an invalid format. Try again; the result was preserved.
messages.A sugestão ainda contém marcadores de co: The suggestion still contains conflict markers. Adjust the guidance and try again.
messages.Sugestão no resultado. Revise antes de a: Suggestion in result. Review before applying.
messages.Salvar o resultado revisado e marcar est: Save the reviewed result and mark this conflict as resolved?
messages.Selecione com Ctrl/⌘+clique ou Shift+cli: Select with Ctrl/⌘+click or Shift+click. Space toggles the selection. Checkboxes stage the commit.
messages.Serão enviadas apenas as versões destes: Only the versions of these files will be sent: staged changes and the files on disk. Unsaved buffers are excluded.
messages.O que deseja saber?: What do you want to know?
messages.Descreva a revisão ou análise para os ar: Describe the review or analysis for the selected files…
messages.Aguarde a operação Git terminar para env: Wait for the Git operation to finish before sending a query.
messages.Revise estas alterações. Aponte bugs, re: Review these changes. Point out bugs, regressions and test gaps, citing the file and the relevant snippet. Prioritize issues by severity.
messages.Analise o impacto destas alterações. Exp: Analyze the impact of these changes. Explain behavior changes, compatibility and risks. Separate demonstrated impacts from hypotheses that need verification.
messages.Há buffers não salvos. Salve-os para inc: There are unsaved buffers. Save them to include those edits in the query.
messages.Descreva o que deseja saber sobre os arq: Describe what you want to know about the selected files.
messages.A orientação é longa demais. Reduza o te: The guidance is too long. Shorten the text before sending.
messages.As alterações selecionadas mudaram duran: The selected changes changed while being read. Try again.
messages.O agente está analisando os arquivos sel: The agent is analyzing the selected files…
messages.Análise concluída para os arquivos lista: Analysis finished for the listed files.
messages.Os arquivos mudaram durante a análise. A: The files changed during the analysis. The response refers to the versions that were sent; ask again to refresh it.
messages.A resposta usa as versões enviadas. Não: The response uses the versions that were sent. It was not possible to check whether the files are still the same.
messages.Selecionar {0} para consultar o agente e: Select {0} to ask the agent and view the diff
messages.Um arquivo selecionado saiu da lista de: A selected file left the changes list. Update the selection and try again.
messages.Os arquivos selecionados são grandes dem: The selected files are too large. Select fewer files to ask the agent.
messages.Selecione arquivos na lista de alteraçõe: Select files in the changes list to ask the agent.

Instalados do GitHub com versão verifica: Installed from GitHub with verified versions. Initial installation requires internet and Git; afterwards they work offline.
